wins.label: Performance category strong growth
wins.evidence: Performance grew double digits in the quarter, with growth in many of our key sports

wins.label: Innovation pipeline acceleration
wins.evidence: we've been accelerating our innovation pipeline, including pulling forward several innovations, some more than a year

wins.label: Gross margin expansion
wins.evidence: Gross margins expanded 110 basis points to 44.7% on a reported basis, primarily due to strategic pricing actions, lower ocean freight rates and improved supply chain efficiency

wins.label: Strong wholesale order books
wins.evidence: strong double-digit growth in order books with North American running specialty partners in both holiday '24 and spring '25

wins.label: Full year EPS growth
wins.evidence: For full year fiscal '24, revenue grew approximately 1% on a currency neutral basis and earnings per share grew 15%

risks.label: Lifestyle business decline
risks.evidence: our lifestyle business declined in Q4 across men's, women's and Jordan, more than offsetting strong growth in our sport performance business

risks.label: Digital channel weakness
risks.evidence: NIKE Digital declined 10% in the quarter. Although our digital business has grown at an approximately 26% CAGR since fiscal '19, we missed our Q4 plan on softer traffic, higher promotions and lower sales of certain classic footwear franchises

risks.label: Greater China traffic decline
risks.evidence: we experienced meaningful shifts in consumer traffic in key markets, particularly in Greater China, where brick-and-mortar traffic declined as much as double digits versus the prior year

risks.label: FY25 revenue guidance lowered significantly
risks.evidence: we now expect fiscal '25 reported revenue to be down mid-single digits with the first half down high single digits

risks.label: Macro uncertainty and FX headwinds
risks.evidence: increased macro uncertainty and worsening foreign exchange have caused us to reduce our guidance for fiscal '25. Foreign exchange headwinds have also worsened and will now have a 1 point translational impact on revenue in fiscal '25
